name: FetLife
summary: The global social network for BDSM, kink, and fetish communities—used primarily for local events, munches, discussion groups, and personal profiles.
ranking_rationale: Irreplaceable as the real-world directory for kink events and niche communities; scored for community utility rather than streaming polish, as search and UI remain bare-bones.

pricing.model: Free community social network + optional Supporter membership
pricing.free_tier: Core profiles, local events, groups, writings, and photo feeds are free
pricing.notes: Core community access is free; optional paid Supporter tier adds video hosting and extra profile tools. Check official site.

pros: Unmatched global directory of local munches, workshops, and kink events
Thousands of active fetish discussion groups and educational threads
Core membership is genuinely free without intrusive ad networks
cons: Not a streaming porn site—video features are basic and secondary
Search and discovery tools are intentionally limited
Interface feels functional and dated compared to modern social apps

facts.value: Launched 2008 by John Baku; operated by BitLove Inc.
Free social network with optional Supporter membership
Local kink event calendars and community-moderated fetish groups
